spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact boundary the feature lives on: chrome.debugger's absence from page context (real typeof checks), navigator.webdriver's actual meaning, and the debugger;-statement's real semantics — explicitly debunking it as a chrome.debugger detector.

interactive.rationale: Re-run probes button refreshes live readouts; the debugger;-statement button really executes one and reports measured elapsed time with the correct interpretation for both outcomes.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index frames it as honest live probes plus a labelled manual observation; the page delivers and labels the non-detectability finding as documentation, not a probe.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles non-Chromium browsers (no chrome object), automation contexts (webdriver true, as in this page's own CDP verification), and the DevTools-open pause path with distinct copy.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5072259281715200, the debugger reference, and MDN navigator.webdriver.

conformance.rationale: The suite's two script assertions are exactly this page's probes (extension-API absence; webdriver boolean + absence), and the infobar disclosure is documented, not asserted.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP matrix both classes: chrome object present, chrome.debugger undefined, navigator.webdriver TRUE under the harness — the automation readout exercised for real; debugger; statement ran via autorun with no pause (CDP session without Debugger domain), matching the page's copy; zero console errors.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the boundary probe result and each debugger-statement run with elapsed/paused details.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; good/warn readout colours on stone at AA.

accessibility.rationale: dl readouts, aria-live notes and results, native buttons, headings sequential.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: auto-fit readout grid; no overflow on either class via CDP.

openQuestions.title: Document the infobar with a captured screenshot from a real attach
openQuestions.detail: The trusted-UI disclosure section is text-only. A real screenshot of the 'started debugging this browser' infobar (taken on hardware with a scratch extension, cropped, alt-texted) would ground it visually. Needs a human-driven capture since no automation in this environment can produce the real infobar.

guidanceConsulted.query: live status readout panel accessible aria-live updates
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Text equivalents for state, polite live regions for async results.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Probe note and debugger-statement result are aria-live=polite with complete-sentence outcomes; colour is redundant.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data readout grid mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: auto-fit minmax readout grids with min-inline-size:0.

summary: The honest page-side concept: what the debugged page can and cannot know. Uniquely, its automation readout (navigator.webdriver true) was exercised for real by this build's own CDP harness.
